item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo’s injury status revealed after calling out Heat’s defensive struggles
item.description: Photo by Carmen Mandato/Getty Images Giannis Antetokounmpo has received an encouraging injury update after the Miami Heat listed him as probable for their upcoming meeting with the Los Angeles Clippers due to a right wrist sprain. The update comes after Miami suffered a 138-117 defeat to the Los Angeles Lakers, leaving them with a 2-5 record in Antetokounmpo’s first season with the franchise. The two-time MVP finished that loss with 30 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists but was left frustrated by the Heat’s defensive performance. Giannis Antetokounmpo expected to play despite wrist injury According to the NBA’s official injury report , Antetokounmpo is listed as probable for Miami’s clash with the Clippers. The designation suggests the Heat expect their star forward to feature, although his availability will be confirmed closer to tip-off. The injury emerged after Antetokounmpo took a hard fall while driving towards the basket against the Lakers. He was seen grabbing his wrist before returning to the game and finishing with 34 minutes on the court. However, his biggest concern after the defeat was not his fitness but Miami’s lack of defensive effort. “We’re not playing hard enough,” Antetokounmpo told reporters, according to the South Florida Sun-Sentinel . “We’ve got to play harder. We’ve got to have some pride.” The Lakers shot 57.3 per cent from the field and made 19 three-pointers, exposing the Heat’s defensive problems. Miami also conceded 60 points in the paint as Luka Doncic finished with 42 points and 13 assists. Despite the difficult start, Antetokounmpo has not lost belief in the team’s potential following his move from the Milwaukee Bucks. “I’m just a basketball player. I just came here to compete. Do I think we have the pieces? Yeah. Do I think we got a lot of things to figure out? We have a lot,” he said. Miami coach Erik Spoelstra has also refused to use the team’s new-look roster as an excuse, while Bobby Portis acknowledged that building chemistry takes time. The Heat now turn their attention to the Clippers, who have lost six consecutive games. With Antetokounmpo expected to feature, Miami will have an opportunity to respond, but improving their defensive effort remains the priority. item.title: 49ers Work Out 8 Defenders as D-Line Draws Focus After Buckner Trade
item.description: ATLANTA, GEORGIA - OCTOBER 25: Head coach Kyle Shanahan of the San Francisco 49ers looks on during the second quarter against the Atlanta Falcons at Mercedes-Benz Stadium on October 25, 2026 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images) Getty Less than a week after trading for DeForest Buckner, the San Francisco 49ers spent half of an eight-player workout looking at defensive tackles. All eight players San Francisco brought in on Tuesday, Nov. 3, were defenders, according to the NFL transaction report. Five were defensive linemen and three were defensive backs. The 49ers host the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 8, coming out of their bye. The split is more revealing than the head count. The 49ers just used a fourth-round pick to bring back a Pro Bowl defensive tackle, and they released cornerback Jack Jones to open his roster spot. On Tuesday, they looked at depth at both positions. 49ers Work Out 4 Defensive Tackles After DeForest Buckner Trade San Francisco worked out defensive tackles Matthew Butler, Aaron Graves, Chris Williams and Kristian Williams, along with defensive end Dominic Bailey. In other words, four of the five linemen on the list play inside. The 49ers sent Indianapolis a 2027 fourth-round pick for Buckner, who started seven games for the Colts this season and recorded four sacks before the trade. A player with that production can change the starting front. The back end of the rotation is a separate roster question, and Tuesday’s list gives San Francisco four more interior options to evaluate. That part of the roster was already moving before the trade. San Francisco released defensive lineman Kevin Givens from the active roster and brought him back on the practice squad. The team also elevated defensive lineman Ogbo Okoronkwo for its game against Atlanta, according to the 49ers’ transaction log . The workouts give the team more options if it needs to make another move in the rotation. Butler has a connection to Sunday’s opponent. The Raiders drafted him in the fifth round in 2022 out of Tennessee and later brought him up from their practice squad. 49ers Look at 3 Defensive Backs After Releasing Jack Jones Christian Braswell, Kyu Blu Kelly and David Long rounded out the workout group. Kelly, a Stanford product, also spent time with Las Vegas. The Raiders signed him to their active roster in 2024 after initially bringing him in on the practice squad. Jones had appeared in seven games for San Francisco this season, registering 11 tackles and three passes defensed, according to his team bio . His departure gives the 49ers a practical reason to look at more defensive backs. The team’s depth chart lists Renardo Green and Deommodore Lenoir at outside cornerback, Upton Stout at nickel and Ephesians Prysock behind Lenoir. The workout entries establish who came in for a look. A practice-squad signing would give the 49ers another player to develop or elevate when needed. item.description: © Jerome Miron-Imagn Images New Ravens QBs taking team pictures at practice sums up hopeless QB situation appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The entire Baltimore Ravens quarterback room is currently dealing with injuries, creating a major concern for the team ahead of its upcoming matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars. The Ravens have reportedly reached a point where all three of their quarterbacks are nursing injuries . The situation has become so concerning that Baltimore has brought in two additional quarterbacks, Kedon Slovis and Austin Reed, to provide some much-needed depth. Both newcomers arrived in Baltimore shortly before practice and had to have their photographs taken before joining the team’s activities. Their last-minute arrival highlights just how urgently the Ravens need reinforcements at quarterback. Lamar Jackson suffered a right thumb injury during Sunday’s 36-10 defeat against the Buffalo Bills. Head coach Jesse Minter confirmed that the former MVP would be placed on injured reserve, with surgery also being considered. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Meanwhile, backup quarterback Tyler Huntley exited the same game with a toe injury, and the possibility of placing him on injured reserve is also being considered. Baltimore rookie Joe Fagnano made his NFL regular-season debut against the Bills after Jackson and Huntley went down. However, he is now dealing with an ankle injury of his own. The undrafted rookie took a low hit from Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver but managed to remain in the game and finish the game. Baltimore’s quarterback problems could not have arrived at a worse time, particularly considering the team’s disappointing start to the season. The Ravens are coming off a heavy defeat against Buffalo and must now prepare for another challenging matchup against the Jaguars without their franchise quarterback. With their quarterback room severely depleted, the Ravens have wasted little time bringing in Reed and Slovis. However, the two newcomers have very little time to familiarize themselves with Baltimore’s offensive system before facing the Jaguars. Minter announced Tuesday that Fagnano will be under center for the upcoming game. Amid the rookie’s own injury concerns, Baltimore’s immediate priority is to get its available quarterbacks prepared for Thursday night. item.title: Naira rises, now N1,374/$ in parallel market
item.description: …As interbank turnover rises 445% By Elizabeth Adegbesan The Naira yesterday appreciated to N1,374 per dollar from N1,377 in the parallel market on Monday. But the naira depreciated to N1,347.75 per dollar in the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market, NFEM. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, showed that the indicative exchange rate for the official market rose slightly to N1,347.75 per dollar from N1,346.01 per dollar on Monday, indicating N1.74 depreciation for the naira. Consequently, the margin between the parallel and official markets narrowed to N26.25 per dollar from N30.99 per dollar on Monday. The value of interbank turnover in NFEM increased sharply by 445.6 percent to $118.95 billion from $21.8 billion on Monday. The post Naira rises, now N1,374/$ in parallel market appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Justin Herbert's Decline: How The Chargers Failed Their Franchise QB
item.description: Sep 13, 2026; Inglewood, California, USA; Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert (10) looks at his play sheet on his wrist during the fourth quarter against the Arizona Cardinals at SoFi Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images For the past few years, Justin Herbert has been viewed as one of the top quarterbacks in the NFL, but his performance this season has raised serious concern. After six years as the Los Angeles Chargers’ franchise QB, he has significantly regressed in his seventh season. Through seven games, he has made questionable decisions and inaccurate throws that have left viewers wondering what happened to the once promising QB. While Herbert deserves criticism for his performance, the Chargers organization needs equal scrutiny for their involvement in his decline. Just How Much Has Justin Herbert Regressed Sep 20, 2026; Inglewood, California, USA; Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert (10) throws a pass against the Las Vegas Raiders during the first half at SoFi Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images Herbert’s decline as a QB is evident on film, but it is even more apparent statistically . For the past six seasons, he has averaged over 225 passing yards per game with a passer rating of over 93; however, this year he is performing well below his established standard. Through seven games, he is averaging under 200 passing yards per game and a passer rating of 69.3, which are both career lows. Though Herbert wasn’t widely seen as on the level of other elite NFL QBs, he held up against them. From 2020 to 2025, his completion percentage was higher than Lamar Jackson’s, his interception rate was lower than Patrick Mahomes’, and his yards per completion was higher than Joe Burrow’s. Instead of continuing this trend, Herbert’s efficiency has regressed, with his completion percentage, interception rate, and yards per completion among the lowest of his career this season. Some of Herbert’s reduction in performance can simply be blamed on his poor decision-making and accuracy. He is throwing the lowest on-target accuracy of his career, with only 74.5% of his attempts being delivered accurately. This precision issue is a contributing factor to his success rate dropping by 11% from last season and his league-worst 10 interceptions this year. For a player of Herbert’s caliber to take this stark of a falloff in only one year, it’s hard to believe that the Los Angeles coaching staff is without fault. item.title: 2026 U17 Super Cup confirmed: Corinthians v Athletico-PR
item.description: 2026 U17 Super Cup confirmed: Corinthians v Athletico-PR 2026 U-17 Super Cup matchup confirmed: Corinthians vs. Athletico-PR Credits: Rafael Ribeiro/CBF and Luis Miguel Ferreira/athletico.com,br Corinthians won the Brazilian U-17 Championship on Tuesday (3) and qualified for the 2026 U-17 Super Cup. In the competition bringing together this year's two national champions in the age group, Timão will face Athletico-PR, winners of the U-17 Copa do Brasil. Both teams will compete for this title for the first time, having secured their places with historic first-time triumphs. On Tuesday night, Corinthians lost 3–1 at Arena Independência in Belo Horizonte but secured the title with a 4–3 aggregate victory, having won the first leg 3–0. The U-17 Super Cup trophy; the competition returned to Brazil's men's youth football calendar in 2026 Credits: Lucas Figueiredo/CBF Furacão, meanwhile, lifted the U-17 Copa do Brasil trophy in May. In the final, they beat Atlético-MG 4–3 on penalties at Arena MRV, also in Belo Horizonte, following a 2–2 draw in regulation time. The U-17 Super Cup will be decided in a single match. Like the U-20 Super Cup, it had not been held for five years. Its three editions took place between 2019 and 2021. In the first, Copa do Brasil winners Palmeiras defeated Brazilian Championship winners Flamengo 4–3 on aggregate. In 2020, the clash between the two tricolor clubs, São Paulo and Fluminense, ended in victory for the São Paulo side. The teams drew 1–1 after 90 minutes, but São Paulo, the Copa do Brasil champions, won 4–2 on penalties. Finally, in 2021, Flamengo were automatically crowned champions after winning both the Brazilian Championship and the Copa do Brasil in the age group. item.title: Man Utd fans stage tennis ball protest against Glazer family and Sir Jim Ratcliffe during Roma clash
item.description: Manchester United v AS Roma - UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 - Getty Images Sport Manchester United fans launched tennis balls onto the Old Trafford pitch to protest the club's ownership before witnessing a dramatic Champions League comeback against Roma. Michael Carrick's struggling side recovered from a two-goal deficit to secure a desperately needed 3-2 victory thanks to Matheus Cunha's late heroics. Dramatic comeback eases the pressure United ended a miserable nine-match winless run by securing a remarkable 3-2 victory over Roma in the Champions League. The hosts endured a nightmare start at Old Trafford, falling two goals behind inside the opening 18 minutes. Matìas Soule struck early for the visitors, and Donyell Malen quickly doubled their advantage from the penalty spot. However, a Bruno Fernandes penalty cut the deficit in second half give Michael Carrick’s side hope. Matheus Cunha became the hero for the Red Devils, scoring twice in the closing stages to complete the spectacular turnaround. The Brazilian's celebration for his second goal earned him a quick second yellow card, but his ten-man team held on for the win. Carrick focuses on the players The crucial victory provided much-needed breathing room for Carrick, whose position has been under intense scrutiny following three straight defeats. However, the United boss insisted he felt no personal relief when the final whistle blew. "Genuinely, no," Carrick explained, as quoted by ESPN . "Whether that's right or wrong, or normal or not, I don't know, but I didn't feel relief. I was genuinely pleased for the players. I could feel their willingness to do well, and so for them to have to dig really deep... that's why we're all here." Protests target the club hierarchy Before the dramatic on-pitch action unfolded, frustrated supporters made their feelings known regarding the club's ownership. Fans threw tennis balls onto the pitch from the Stretford End, causing a brief delay to the match. Green and gold balloons also rained down as part of a pre-planned protest aimed at the Glazer family and minority owner Jim Ratcliffe. The demonstration was specifically timed for the 21st minute to mark 21 years of the Glazers' controversial ownership. Supporters remain angry over increased ticket prices and the club's severe on-field struggles. Ratcliffe has overseen the dismissal of two managers since acquiring his minority stake, but the club still finds itself languishing in 17th place in the Premier League. Turning attention to Aston Villa Despite the monumental European victory, The Red Devils must quickly refocus their efforts on domestic matters. The club's historically bad start to the Premier League campaign leaves them hovering precariously above the relegation zone. Carrick and his players face a difficult test against Aston Villa on Sunday. Securing back-to-back victories before the international break could prove vital for the manager's long-term future at the club.

item.title: Cowboys’ Dak Prescott Trade Chance Faces 1 Big Obstacle
item.description: Dak Prescott #4 of the Dallas Cowboys Getty It’s only natural, as this Dallas Cowboys season has descended into a certain wretched desperation at 3-5 and with few avenues emerging for considerable improvement other than a poor division and a weak schedule, that attention turns to major overhauls. Not just tweaks and benchings, but a full-on NFL rebuild. And if the Cowboys need to truly start over, a case could be made that the restart must begin at the most important position in sports and the most expensive player on the roster: Quarterback Dak Prescott. Yes, what once seemed a bridge too far has, at least, been broached by credible Cowboys thinkers. There is chatter about potentially trading away Prescott, the 11th year veteran who holds the franchise records for yardage, completions and touchdowns. Prescott is among the best quarterbacks in the NFL, but clearly, something has not clicked between him and this franchise–he is just 2-5 as a playoff quarterback and is looking at his third straight year of not making the postseason outright. He would be a high-value trade target for any franchise in need of a new QB, and that’s at least worth considering for the Cowboys. #Cowboys Trade Of Dak Prescott 'Murmurs' Feature $86 Million Worth Of Problems by @FishSports https://t.co/UlrmDMV3Ky— fishsports ✭ (@fishsports) November 3, 2026 Dak Prescott’s No-Trade Clause Looms But there is a big problem there: Dak Prescott is among the few players who has a no-trade clause in his contract, and it would be a massive longshot to think that Prescott would want to allow the Cowboys to trade him. Yes, Prescott wants to win, but he is also 33 years old with a settled life in Texas, and two daughters with his ex-fiancee. Per Spotra c: “According to our data, 12 #NFL players currently hold a full no-trade clause. Will Anderson (HOU) Joe Burrow (CIN) Myles Garrett (LAR) Jared Goff (DET) Justin Herbert (LAC) Jalen Hurts (PHI) Lamar Jackson (BAL) Trevor Lawrence (JAX) Patrick Mahomes (KC) Dak Prescott (DAL) Brock Purdy (SF) Deshaun Watson (CLE) A Prescott trade would also come with financial ramifications–he has cap hits of $76 million and $84 million in the next two seasons, and the Cowboys are on the hook for considerable dead money going forward. But the no-trade clause is the big issue. Time for Cowboys to Talk? Still, it’s a topic worth considering. The Cowboys would need to work with Prescott to secure the right trade destination, and find him a team that would likely rework his contract to his satisfaction. item.title: Maple Leafs Trade Speculation Grows After Kris Draper Sighting
item.description: The latest Kris Draper sighting has fueled speculation about a potential deal between the Red Wings and the Maple Leafs. Getty Things have taken an interesting turn for the Toronto Maple Leafs and the Utah Mammoth as another Kris Draper sighting hangs in the backdrop of the action on the ice. The Toronto-Utah matchup is a very convenient one for the Detroit Red Wings assistant GM. According to David Pagnotta of The Fourth Period, Draper was taking in the action on Tuesday night. The Kris Draper Tour continues, it appears. The Red Wings’ AGM, along with the team’s Director of Statistical Analysis Bryan Campbell, are on the list for tonight’s Utah/Leafs game here in Toronto. — David Pagnotta (@TheFourthPeriod) November 4, 2026 Now, it’s a very interesting situation as both the Maple Leafs and the Mammoth have been linked to players on the block in Detroit. The Mammoth remain on the fringes of the Dylan Larkin sweepstakes. Utah has been trying to bring in a big-ticket player, most recently pushing hard to land Connor Hellebuyck. As for the Maple Leafs, the talk has been focused on Simon Edvinsson. The Leafs have indicated that they want to upgrade the blue line , and, well, the Red Wings have been looking to make a deal for their still-an-RFA defenseman. Of course, there’s no guarantee that anything is imminent at this point. But one does have to wonder what specifically Draper may be looking at. Whatever the case, the sighting could indicate that something may be afoot. Maple Leafs Have Been Looking for a Younger Defensive Upgrade Toronto’s interest in Edvinsson isn’t particularly surprising. The Maple Leafs have been looking beyond a short-term defensive fix, with management reportedly interested in adding a younger defenseman who can become part of the team’s core. Toronto doesn’t simply need another body on the blue line. It needs someone who can help stabilize the defense now while providing some long-term upside. Edvinsson checks plenty of those boxes. At 23, the 6-foot-6 defenseman has already logged 175 NHL games and has shown he can handle meaningful minutes. He also brings the size and mobility that are difficult to find in a young defenseman. David Pagnotta has reported that Toronto is among the clubs to have inquired about Edvinsson. The problem, however, is the price. Detroit has little reason to give away a former sixth-overall pick, particularly with several teams reportedly checking in. The Leafs also have to consider the contract situation. Edvinsson remains unsigned, and his next deal could carry a substantial price tag. That means Toronto would have to be comfortable with both the trade compensation and the financial commitment before making a serious push. Still, the interest makes sense. The Maple Leafs want to get younger on the back end, and Edvinsson represents the kind of player who could help them accomplish that. What Could Kris Draper Be Looking for in Toronto? item.title: In Class AA girls' soccer final, Bethlehem outlasts Ballston Spa in PKs
item.description: Bethlehem junior June McCarthy and Ballston Spa senior Leah Szmarz race to the ball during the Section 2, Class AA finals on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, at Shaker High School in Colonie, NY. (Jim Franco/Times Union) (Jim Franco/Times Union) LATHAM - First-year Bethlehem girls' soccer coach Scott Geis spent plenty of time getting his team ready for a potentially season-deciding slate of penalty kicks. Tuesday night at Shaker High School, that work paid off. The Eagles played to a thrilling 1-1 draw with Ballston Spa after 110 minutes in the Section 2 Class AA championship game, but Bethlehem stamped its ticket to the state tournament, advancing 4-2 on penalty kicks. "We practice it non-stop," Geis said. "We practice it with me in the goal. … I would shout, ‘Hey, this is the most important shot you've ever taken.' Just pressure, pressure, pressure - and, each time, they laughed it off, they breathed through it and they put it home just like they did today." No. 2 seed Bethlehem (10-4-4 overall) got a huge momentum burst to start the PKs when junior goalie Kinley Logsdon made a diving save to deny Ballston Spa's first shooter, Abby Werner. It was Logsdon's first-ever round of PKs in high school, but she's been through them at the club level. "I know the pressure," she said. "I know I can deal with it." The fifth-seeded Scotties (9-5-5 overall) were also denied in PKs when Charlotte Haskell's attempt hit the post. All four Bethlehem players who stepped up to the penalty spot - Maira Braddock, June McCarthy, Mallory Maycrink and Elayna Shersky - calmly converted their attempts. "As soon as I got it on frame, I knew we had it in the bag," Braddock said. "We've done this so many times in practice. It was just constant repetition. It felt the same. It felt like what we always do." Ballston Spa coach Tom Rogan, who won 348 games and nine sectional titles during a legendary tenure at Bethlehem, expressed pride in his team's run, but acknowledged the heartbreak of season-ending PKs. "It's a hard thing. It's almost harder than losing, in a weird sort of way," he said. Ballston Spa controlled most of the first half, taking the lead on a Haley Wiltsie goal 8:03 before halftime. A spectacular solo effort from Braddock netted the tying goal four minutes into the second half, and the following 36 minutes of regulation and 30 minutes of overtime were a flurry of near-misses on both sides, including a shot off the crossbar by McCarthy late in the first overtime. "I was up, I was down," Geis said. "I was all over the place. I feel like I lost about 10 years." Key moment Braddock simply wasn't going to be denied the game's tying goal. Four minutes into the second half, the sophomore standout collected the ball 40 yards from goal and charged down the left wing with a Ballston Spa defender on her hip the entire way. However, Braddock refused to be dispossessed, and when Ballston Spa goalie Avery DiNallo came off her line, Braddock coolly slipped a shot past her that rolled

item.title: What is the 'Temple' device Shubman Gill wore during IND vs NZ 1st ODI in Auckland? ICC rules on advertising brand devices during matches explored
item.description: What is the 'Temple' device Shubman Gill wore during IND vs NZ 1st ODI in Auckland? ICC rules on advertising brand devices during matches explored originally appeared on Cricket News . Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . KEY TAKEAWAYS: Shubman Gill sported the Temple device on the side of his head during India vs New Zealand 1st ODI in Auckland. Gill wore the device for the opening few overs of the first match of the series. Indian bowlers dominated New Zealand in the first innings of the 1st ODI at Eden Park. Shubman Gill spotted wearing the Temple device during India vs New Zealand 1st ODI in Auckland The ‘Temple’ device that Shubman Gill wore at the start of the first ODI against New Zealand in Auckland is a small wearable stuck to the side of the forehead, and it is designed to track blood flow in the brain. Gill has worn the gadget throughout the tour of New Zealand and was also seen with it during his training sessions. It drew far more notice on Wednesday, however, once India and New Zealand took the field at Eden Park. Gill is not the only Indian athlete to have tried it. Badminton star PV Sindhu wore the same device during the World Championships in New Delhi in August, so it has already appeared on a major stage in another sport. The sight has also raised a fair question about whether such a device is allowed in international cricket, and this report explains what Temple is, what it claims to measure and what the ICC’s rules say about wearable technology and branding. MORE: IND vs NZ 1st ODI 2026 live scorecard, toss winner, winning probability, result and highlights from Eden Park, Auckland Shubman Gill makes a first-of-its-kind appearance, sporting the Temple wearable device during an international cricket match! 🏏🇮🇳 #ShubmanGill #odi #temple https://t.co/ElWtpGbbHc — DRS (@DrRichakS) November 4, 2026 What is the Temple device Shubman Gill wore in the IND vs NZ 1st ODI? Temple is a wearable made by a team associated with Zomato co-founder Deepinder Goyal. It sits on the side of the forehead near the temple and is built to track cerebral blood flow along with other physiological signals linked to how the brain is working. The device relies on optical sensors and a system called BrainFlow. In simple terms, the technology is meant to pick up changes in blood flow inside the brain through signals read from the side of the forehead. MORE: IND vs NZ full head-to-head record and series results in New Zealand How does the Temple wearable work? Beyond blood flow, the device also aims to follow signals tied to oxygenation and cognitive load. That means it tries to gauge how the body and brain respond when mental effort goes up, which is a situation that matters a great deal for a player batting or captaining in a pressure game. item.title: Why Dodgers, Padres must consider Jazz Chisholm Jr. free agency pursuit
item.description: Credit: Robert Deutsch-Imagn Images Why Dodgers, Padres must consider Jazz Chisholm Jr. free agency pursuit appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . It’s safe to say that Jazz Chisholm Jr. didn’t have the season he envisioned he would have, especially when he’s now headed to free agency. His numbers across the board for the New York Yankees were down last season, and this downturn in performance could not have come at a worse time. And it looks like the Yankees are preparing to bid Chisholm farewell. They did not tender a qualifying offer worth $23.15 million to the 28-year-old infielder, which, at the very least, signals that they aren’t willing to bring him back at that price point. However, despite Chisholm’s decline in performance last season, one would think that there are some teams that will look to buy low on him. For example, those at Talking Baseball have floated four possible landing spots for Chisholm: the Los Angeles Dodgers , San Diego Padres , Houston Astros, and New York Mets. Those teams could choose to overlook the steep decline in his offensive production (he fell from an .813 OPS and 31 home runs in 2025 to just .711 OPS and 19 long balls in 2026) and see that Chisholm still put up 3.5 fWAR on the back of his strong defensive and baserunning metrics. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) We could see Jazz Chisholm Jr. going to the Dodgers, Mets, Padres or Astros on a three to four-year deal worth around $100 million pic.twitter.com/1XJM2bTZOw — Talkin' Baseball (@TalkinBaseball_) November 3, 2026 Chisholm stole 41 bases last season, a career-high for a single season, and he measured well in defensive range, according to advanced metrics such as Statcast’s Outs Above Average and Fielding Run Value. Some are projecting Chisholm to sign a contract worth around $90-110 million over three to four seasons, which could make him well worth it at that price point. And here’s why the Dodgers and Padres would benefit immensely from signing the electric, if inconsistent, middle infielder. Dodgers bring in another lefty bat with speed, bolster their defense Jonathan Dyer-Imagn Images If there’s a team that’s already boasting an embarrassment of riches and doesn’t exactly need Chisholm’s services, it’s the Dodgers. They already have Tommy Edman anyway to cover that position, and he’s locked under a long-term contract (he has four years left on his contract worth around $47.5 million). The Dodgers also have a ton of lefties in the lineup, and it might not be the best idea to get another same-sided hitter. For instance, the Dodgers’ primary starters across four positions are left-handed hitters, and their top prospect waiting in the wings (Josue de Paula) is yet another lefty. At this point, the Dodgers might be better off conserving their resources for a right-handed bat to help replace Teoscar Hernandez’s declining power production . item.title: Police rescue Nigerian woman sold for N770,000 in Mali
item.description: By Kingsley Omonobi The Nigeria Police Force has rescued a 21-year-old Nigerian woman trafficked to Mali and forced into prostitution, arresting three suspected members of an international human trafficking syndicate. The operation was carried out by operatives of the Special Tactical Squad, Force Intelligence Department (STS-FID), following an intelligence-led investigation into the trafficking network. The development was disclosed during a press briefing by ACP Victor Ogbeide Godfrey, who coordinated the operation. He said the suspects were arrested between October 1 and 27, 2026. The suspects were identified as Daniel Aondofa, 26; Orgba Solomon, 28, also known as Terry; and ThankGod Ocho, 25. All three are indigenes of Benue State, while Solomon was identified as the alleged leader of the syndicate. The police said the victim, Patience Darius, from Akwanga, Nasarawa State, was lured by Solomon with promises of lucrative employment opportunities abroad. According to the police, she was taken to Lagos on September 26 before being moved through illegal border routes into the Benin Republic and subsequently transported to gold-mining camps in Mali, where women were allegedly forced into prostitution. Solomon reportedly confiscated her mobile phone and travel documents before taking her out of Nigeria, cutting off communication with her family and friends. Upon arrival in Mali, she was allegedly handed over to two individuals identified as Mohammed and Marian, also known as Riana, before being sold for 420,000 CFA francs, equivalent to approximately N770,000. Recounting her ordeal, the victim said she was severely beaten for refusing to engage in prostitution and subsequently taken to a shrine, where she was forced to take a blood oath. The police report quoted her as saying that when she refused to engage in prostitution, she was “beaten blue and black” and taken to a shrine, where she was forced to take a blood oath before being compelled into prostitution. The Force said the investigation began after the victim’s sister lodged a complaint, prompting operatives to deploy digital intelligence to track the trafficking network. It said Solomon was arrested after returning to Nigeria to recruit more women for trafficking to Senegal and Mali, while the two other suspects were also apprehended. The suspects reportedly confessed to their involvement in the crime and provided information that facilitated the victim’s rescue from Mali. The police further disclosed that Darius alleged that about 42 Nigerian women were being held in a makeshift camp within a gold-mining settlement in Mali, where they were subjected to forced prostitution and slave-like conditions. According to the victim, the women were kept under strict surveillance, making escape almost impossible. item.title: Kevin Durant Openly Dismisses Courtside Rockets Fan for Sharing Mid-Game Motivation vs. Celtics
item.description: IMAGO / Icon Sportswire ©Credit - Imago Whether offline or online, Kevin Durant and his fan interactions don’t seem to stop. This time, it wasn’t a hater, though. KD is accustomed to hearing advice to stop defenders trying to slow him down. But during Houston’s recent matchup against the Celtics, it was a courtside fan who decided to offer the 19-year veteran some encouragement. Slim Reaper’s response was characteristically blunt, turning a simple exchange into a viral moment. The exchange involved Sami, a 21-year-old basketball content creator known as @sami_fa3 . Sitting courtside, he called out to Kevin Durant during the game, urging him to keep shooting despite Boston sending multiple defenders his way. “KD, you just gotta keep shooting, man. Don’t matter if they got two on you. They can’t hold you!” When a superstar shuts down a fan's attempt to get in his head, you know the stakes are high. Subscribe to stay across every heated moment and mind game in the NBA. Kevin Durant turned toward him and delivered a short response: “Go on YouTube and watch me workout, if you wanna see that.” Sami took the advice literally, pulling out his phone and looking up Durant’s workout videos while the game continued. He wasn’t satisfied with it. The moment became even better when Kevin Durant soon knocked down a basket in front of him. The fan had asked for a reminder of what the superstar could do, and Durant supplied one without saying another word. Setting the exchange aside, Kevin Durant really had a tough day at the office. The superstar almost had a perfect shooting night, except he just ‌shot the ball 6 times and made 5 of them. For a player with Durant’s scoring reputation, attempting just six shots was unusual, particularly in a matchup against one of the league’s strongest defensive teams. The Celtics had made a deliberate choice to take the ball out of his hands. Jayson Tatum and Sam Hauser were among the defenders assigned to him, while the Celtics repeatedly sent extra attention whenever Durant tried to operate. The strategy forced Houston to find other ways to generate offense. That opened the door for Alperen Sengun. The 6’11” center delivered one of his best performances of the season. The Rockets center finished with 26 points, 10 assists, and 7 rebounds, shooting 12-of-15 from the field. Rather than allowing Boston’s coverage to stall the offense, Houston used the space created by Durant’s presence to get Sengun involved. Kevin Durant’s minimum shooting night didn’t just end up as a courtside fan interaction. The media also pressed Durant on his game. item.title: Dwyane Wade gets brutally honest about Bam Adebayo's role on the Miami Heat
item.description: Dwyane Wade gets brutally honest about Bam Adebayo's role on the Miami Heat originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . It has not been the best start for the Miami Heat this season. While Giannis Antetokounmpo has done his best to lead the Heat , he cannot do all of it alone. That responsibility must fall to his co-star, Bam Adebayo. Unfortunately, Adebayo is in a down year so far. While he has been decent over the past three games, people have seen the lows of Adebayo's game, especially in the first few games of the season when he truly struggled. Dwyane Wade has become brutally honest about Bam Adebayo Before the 2026-27 season started, there was tons of hype surrounding Miami. They just got Giannis Antetokounmpo, so they had the superstar to pair with Adebayo. Unfortunately, it has not worked out so far. Of course, it is early in their first season together, but it does not look good so far. This has led to fans criticizing Adebayo because it seems that he is the one struggling while Antetokounmpo is thriving despite the lack of wins. MORE: Bam Adebayo has taken accountability for the Heat's slow start As a Heat player who succeeded with stars throughout his career, Wade knows what it's like to work with big names. That is why he wants to see Adebayo taking charge of the situation just like he did when he was playing with Shaquille O'Neal early on and LeBron James later in his career. "He gotta be the number 1 option with the 2nd unit guys. Point blank period. You can’t be a role player with the role players... There’s no rhythm, flow to the game. You’d expect them to be a really good defensive team," Wade said on his podcast about Adebayo's role on the Heat . "They’re not a team yet. Bunch of individual guys that haven’t had uncomfortable conversations yet. They’re great guys individually, but you have to get to some uncomfortable stuff." Miami would be so much better if Adebayo does take charge when Antetokounmpo is out. However, he also has to make better choices, so the offense will be much more efficient. Working on his game will do a lot, so he has to take charge and improve as well. item.title: ADC’s struggle to campaign
item.description: There was an air of uncertainty on Tuesday over whether the flag-off of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign in Sokoto State scheduled for Wednesday (today) would be held as planned. Daily Trust gathered that, as of Tuesday evening, the party was still struggling to secure a venue for the event, mobilise supporters, and make other basic logistical arrangements for the rally. Our correspondents report that the event was initially scheduled for Saturday, October 31, but was shifted to Wednesday due to the alleged takeover of hotel bookings by the state government, which has denied the claim. It was learnt that due to problems of logistics, some ADC leaders in the state offered their homes and guest houses to accommodate party leaders and other dignitaries arriving for the party’s presidential campaign flag-off. Benue APC: Rival Tinubu campaign lists deepen factional rift Can the North afford to continue without its own ‘Parapo’? Some party leaders confirmed this in separate interviews with our correspondents, saying they resorted to providing private accommodation after failing to secure hotel rooms for their guests. Spokesman for the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, Aminu Abubakar, said the party was yet to secure hotel accommodation, prompting members to volunteer their residences and guest houses. “Some of them have offered their homes, while others have provided their guest houses to accommodate our visitors. That is where we are putting them up,” he said. Another party chieftain, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said some prominent party leaders had already arrived in Sokoto ahead of the event. He said they include the party’s National Secretary and former Osun State Governor, Rauf Aregbesola; Senator Dino Melaye; and the party’s governorship candidate in Kaduna State, Isa Ashiru Kudan. The source added that more party leaders and dignitaries were expected to arrive Tuesday night or early Wednesday. However, the party was yet to officially announce the exact venue of the rally as of the time of filing this report. Supporters of the ADC in Sokoto yesterday An unverified source claimed that the event would take place at the Trade Fair Complex, while another source said it would be held at the party’s office premises along Ahmadu Bello Way, which was recently sealed by the state government. A source familiar with the arrangement alleged that the party had been asked to pay N20 million for the use of the Trade Fair Complex. According to the source, the party had agreed to the payment and requested the account details to enable it to transfer the money, but the details had yet to be provided. Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign Council, Bello Muhammad Goronyo, when contacted for clarification on the arrival of party leaders and the venue of the event declined to comment, saying he was not aware of the arrival of the guests or where the presidential campaign flag-off would take place. item.title: Before the Dawn in America’s Heartland
item.description: Earth Observatory Science Earth Observatory Before the Dawn in America’s… Earth Earth Observatory Image of the Day EO Explorer Topics All Topics Atmosphere Land Heat & Radiation Life on Earth Human Dimensions Natural Events Oceans Remote Sensing Technology Snow & Ice Water More Content Collections Global Maps World of Change Articles Earth Matters Blog Blue Marble: Next Generation EO Kids Mission: Biomes About About Us Subscribe 🛜 RSS Contact Us Search October 18, 2026 The predawn hours brought clear skies over much of the eastern United States on October 18, 2026. An astronaut aboard the International Space Station seized the opportunity to capture this wide-angle photo at 4:54 a.m. Central Daylight Time (09:54 Universal Time), with illuminated cities large and small arrayed across the darkened landscape. The U.S. Midwest’s largest metropolitan areas , such as Chicago, Illinois, and Detroit, Michigan, stand out as some of the brightest features. Mid-sized cities—including Indianapolis, Indiana; Cincinnati, Ohio; and Louisville, Kentucky—and their interconnections along state and interstate highways also shine brightly. Above the web of nighttime lights and Earth’s lower atmosphere, a diffuse layer of green and orange is visible along the horizon to the left. This band of light is airglow , produced when sunlight strikes atoms and molecules in the upper atmosphere and causes them to eject photons . To the right, light from the Sun arcs across the horizon; sunrise was about an hour away on the East Coast and about two hours away in Chicago. Astronaut photos and other remote sensing observations of nighttime lights are scientifically valuable for tracking changes in the built environment. For example, Chicago’s lightscape appears a homogeneous pale yellow in the wide view above. But in detailed photos, like the one below, a range of colors stemming from different types of lighting is discernible. Using NASA’s extensive Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth archive, researchers have developed a method for distinguishing lighting types within the pixels of nighttime photos. Systematically quantifying urban lights’ brightness, color, and extent can provide insight into how cities grow and evolve . March 1, 2024 Satellite sensors also observe changes to lighting. In particular, NASA’s Black Marble nighttime lights product suite uses satellite observations to produce science-quality records of nighttime lights across the globe at daily, monthly, and yearly time scales. In the eastern U.S., scientists have used these data to track everything from power outages and restoration following major storms to lighting changes associated with new infrastructure to transitions to LED lighting from older forms. item.title: AMD on track to overtake Intel as biggest x86 outfit
item.description: AMD has predicted it will win more revenue than Intel in its next quarter, potentially marking the first time it becomes the dominant vendor whose main product is x86 processors. The house of Zen on Tuesday announced its Q3 2026 results, which saw it grow revenue 45 percent year-over-year to $13.4 billion. The company’s Data Center segment won $8.5 billion of revenue, up 97 percent year-over-year. Sales of silicon in AMD’s client and gaming segment slid eight percent to $3.7 billion, a worse fall than the five percent fall that helped to sink Intel’s share price . Intel, AMD’s great rival in the x86 market, offered revenue guidance of $15 billion to $16 billion for its next quarter, which would represent almost no growth. AMD, by contrast, told investors it expects around $17 billion of revenue next quarter. CEO Lisa Su predicted even better days are ahead. “We think 2027 is going to be a very strong momentum year for both the CPU business as well as the data center AI business,” she said on the company’s earnings call. “We have said the overall company will grow greater than 80 percent, and for the data center CPU business, we will about double, and for the data center AI business, it will significantly more than double.” Su said AMD is confident its supply chain can meet that demand. “We have worked across our supply chain to secure the wafers, substrates, advanced packaging, memory, and other key components needed to support much higher growth next year,” she said. “We are also deepening our collaboration with our supply chain partners and investing alongside them to secure the long-term capacity our growth will require.” The CEO added that AMD has “strong confidence in our ability to sustain exceptional revenue growth for years to come, with earnings growing even faster.” If those predictions are correct, AMD will likely accelerate away from Intel to become the leading provider of x86 processors after years of challenging Chipzilla's lead. Intel would still have higher overall revenue, due to its foundry operations, but in terms of revenue earned from selling chips, AMD would become the market leader. AMD is arguably already the server CPU technology leader, and while it is second to Nvidia in the GPU market has trounced Intel. Even AMD's declining client and gaming revenue has an upside because it was the gaming part of the portfolio that created the problem. PC chip sales rose seven percent year-over-year to $2.9 billion. Su said strong sales of Ryzen mobile processors drove that growth. “Commercial is becoming a larger part of our client business as large enterprises adopt Ryzen PRO PCs across their employee base,” she said, pointing to strong adoption at the world’s largest banks, automotive companies, and healthcare concerns. Big corporate buyers are often a source of bigger profits and/or steadier revenue, so AMD looks to be taking the cream off the top of the PC market rather than scrounging for SMB and retail scraps. item.title: Experts seek soil-based fertiliser recommendations to improve yields
item.description: By Cynthia Alo Agricultural experts have called for a shift from one-size-fits-all fertiliser recommendations to soil-based application, warning that farmers may be wasting money on nutrients their crops do not need. They said differences in soil conditions and crop requirements meant that applying the same fertiliser rates across farming locations could result in poor nutrient use, higher production costs and lower productivity. The experts spoke at the 2026 Nigeria Fertiliser Summit on Phosphorus and Food Security, organised by the Institute of Agricultural Research and Training (IAR&T), Obafemi Awolowo University and the Fertilizer Producers and Suppliers Association of Nigeria (FEPSAN), with the Fertilizer and Inputs Support Services Department of the Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security as co-convener in Abuja. Findings presented at the summit by the Regional Hub for Fertilizer and Soil Health for West Africa and the Sahel showed that phosphorus requirements for maize and rice in northern Nigeria ranged from zero to more than 60 kilogrammes of phosphorus pentoxide per hectare, depending on soil conditions. Phosphorus is an essential plant nutrient that supports root development, crop growth and grain formation. However, its availability to crops varies with soil properties and farming conditions. A soil scientist and modelling expert at IAR&T, Prof. Vincent Aduramigba-Modupe, said improving agricultural productivity required more than increasing fertiliser application. “Improving crop productivity is not only about applying fertiliser. It is about ensuring the right nutrient is applied in the right amount, at the right place, and under the right conditions,” he said. The Minister of Agriculture and Food Security, Aliyu Abdullahi, represented by the Director of Agricultural Land and Climate Change Management Services, Oshadiya Olanipekun, emphasised soil data, testing and crop-specific fertiliser recommendations as important tools for improving farmers’ outcomes. Also speaking, Prof. Jibrin Mohammed Jibrin, Visiting Scientist with the Regional Hub and Professor of Soil Science at Bayero University, Kano, described soil information as fundamental to food production. Jibrin also called for better coordination among agricultural stakeholders, warning that fragmented interventions could undermine efforts to improve soil health. “The basis of food production and food security is the soil. You need healthy soil to produce well and feed the nation with nutritious food. To do that, you need soil intelligence. “Too many initiatives have been implemented in silos. Real progress will come when stakeholders align, collaborate and follow through on agreed actions,” he said. Senior Agronomist at the Regional Hub, Dr. Bello Shehu, said improving phosphorus management was not about applying more fertiliser but understanding the nutrient requirements of different soils and crops. item.description: …PDP candidate’s supporters pledge grassroots mobilisation for ‘Ogun for Ogun’ agenda By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta Indigenes of Ogun State have reaffirmed their support for the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) governorship candidate, Oladipupo Adebutu, and his running mate, Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo, pledging grassroots mobilisation for their ambition ahead of the 2027 governorship election. The pledge was made during ward-to-ward engagements by the candidates across local government areas of the state, where residents expressed concerns about poor infrastructure, unemployment, inadequate agricultural support and the need for improved access to modern farming equipment. The campaign tour is also aimed at presenting the candidates’ seven-point development agenda, tagged ITURA DE, to the electorate. At the ward meetings, community leaders, market women, farmers and youths turned out to receive the candidates and discuss their expectations from the next administration. Several stakeholders pledged support for the ‘Ogun for Ogun’ initiative, arguing that the state’s leadership should reflect the interests, heritage and aspirations of its indigenes. At Alagada Ward in Obafemi Owode Local Government Area, a market leader, Mrs Folasade Ogunye, said her support for the movement was informed by the belief that indigenous leadership would better understand the challenges confronting grassroots communities. She lamented the poor condition of roads leading to markets and the limited employment opportunities available to young people, pledging to mobilise women for door-to-door campaigns. “We, the women of Obafemi Owode, have suffered neglect. Our roads to the markets are bad, and our children need jobs. We want someone who grew up here, who knows our language and understands our struggles,” she said. At Alapakooni community, also in Obafemi Owode, some residents said to be former members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) publicly renounced their membership of the party. The defectors reportedly set bunches of APC brooms ablaze to symbolise their departure, citing dissatisfaction with the party’s political leadership and questions surrounding the identity of its governorship candidate. A community youth coordinator, Tunde Akinola, said their decision to align with Adebutu was motivated by their desire for leadership they could identify with and hold accountable. He said the group wanted to support a candidate who understood the state’s challenges and could deliver on his promises. Similarly, a community stakeholder and farmer at Onidunu Ward, Deji Bamidele, said farmers in the area wanted a government that would prioritise agricultural development through mechanisation and improved access to farming inputs. He said a farmers’ cooperative with more than 300 members had pledged support for the ‘Ogun for Ogun’ initiative, following Adebutu’s presentation of his agricultural plans under the ITURA DE agenda. item.title: Aussie Adobe assailant Canva announces layoffs in re-org affecting 22% of staff
item.description: Australian design software maker Canva is restructuring, with 1,271 employees, or 22 percent of its workforce, facing layoffs, changes to their roles, or requests to relocate. The company, which has become a challenger to Adobe, announced the news by sharing a message that CEO Melanie Perkins sent to staff on Wednesday. That missive, titled “An important update on our team,” doesn’t mention AI but does state “New technology is transforming what people can create, how they create it, and what they expect from the products they use.” Perkins observed that Canva’s rate of growth recently slowed for the first time in a decade and shared her view that continued success won’t happen without change. “After exploring a wide range of alternatives, I've come to the difficult conclusion that small changes won’t be enough,” she wrote. “To set ourselves up for the next decade, we need to refound Canva, getting back to our roots of small, empowered teams with the freedom to make decisions, take ownership and focus on what matters most for our community.” The CEO did not say how many jobs would go, but argued the changes are necessary because the company has become inefficient. The changes will therefore see Canva combine its product, growth and platform teams into a single “Product Org,” which Perkins says means “changing the way we work to provide clearer ownership, greater autonomy and flexibility to tackle our most important goals.” She characterized the changes as “simplifying layers, consolidating overlapping responsibilities, and ensuring teams have the right mix of skills and experience for the chapter ahead.” The CEO three times described herself as “deeply sorry” for the changes. Affected staff will receive a calendar invite for an optional individual meeting with a senior leader. Remaining staff get to attend two rounds of meetings next week – one company-wide affair and another with their reorganized teams. Another of Perkins’ decisions will see Canva move more of its product teams to its headquarters in Sydney, Australia. The company will ask some staff to relocate and has promised “comprehensive support” to make that happen. Departing staff can keep their company-issued MacBooks and will receive at least six months' pay, a year of health insurance, plus various forms of support to find a new gig including a one-year membership of LinkedIn Premium. Perkins’ post does not cite financial pressures as a reason for the layoffs. Canva is privately held and does not face the same financial disclosure requirements as a listed business, but last year revealed it had 260 million monthly users and revenue of $3.5 billion. Execs have previously claimed the company is profitable on a free-cash-flow basis. Canva and Atlassian are among Australia’s most successful and celebrated technology businesses. Both have now announced job cuts this year. ®

item.title: Feet-stiffening socks could help you run further for longer
item.description: The socks you wear while running could make a big difference to your personal best Artur Widak/NurPhoto/Shutterstock Introducing tight bands in socks around the ball of the foot seems to make walking and running easier. The effects of these socks, which stiffen the feet, are equivalent to the reduced energy expenditure that the average person would experience if they lost 2 kilograms, according to the researchers behind them. Owen Beck at the University of Texas at Austin says he hopes to see elite runners in the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics using these socks, which he developed with Hui Tang , also at the University of Texas at Austin. “Our back-of-the-envelope estimates suggest that wrapping the foot in the new socks could improve marathon performance by 1 to 2 minutes,” says Beck. Read more Why slow running could be even more beneficial than running fast Since diverging from chimpanzees around 6 million years ago, human feet have become much stiffer than those of other apes, which assisted our bipedalism. Beck and Tang first wondered if they could take this stiffness further by tweaking footwear. However, previous attempts to reduce walking and running effort using shoes with stiffer midsoles or inserts have failed, so then the pair turned to socks. Advertisement They are made of a common synthetic yarn blend, typical of athletic socks. Beck and Tang tightly knitted three 1-millimetre wide bands at a 30-millimetre-wide region around the ball of the foot. This results in 24 times more pressure being applied to feet compared with regular, control socks. To test them, they recruited 12 adults of both sexes who had no known health conditions. The researchers analysed how they walked while wearing the foot-stiffening socks, control socks and no socks. Free newsletter Sign up to Health Check Sign up to newsletter Participants then walked on a treadmill while wearing shoes with the stiffened socks and control ones for 5 minutes. Beck and Tang measured their VO2 max, the maximum amount of oxygen the body can absorb during high-intensity exercise. This allowed them to determine how much energy they burned in each of the walking experiments, known as metabolic expenditure. The foot-stiffening socks reduced this expenditure in 10 of 12 of the participants by 2 per cent more than the control socks. That is equivalent to the average person losing 2 kilograms, according to the researchers. This reduced expenditure probably doesn’t mean the socks lead to wearers getting fewer health benefits, such as weight loss, from walking or running compared with those wearing regular socks, says Beck. “Reducing the whole-body metabolic rate means we have better walking endurance, we sweat less during hot days and we can walk faster for the same effort [that we would use] using commercially available socks.” The socks work by enabling the ankle and its muscles to push off at a slower velocity, he says. item.title: Funke Akindele, Waje & Shoday’s London Looks Belong in Our Style Notes | See Photos
item.description: Funke Akindele, Shoday, and Waje smiling during their London promotional walk ahead of The Four UK premiere. Upon seeing these photos of Funke Akindele , Shoday and Waje , we had no choice but to pull out our notes, ready for some styling lessons. Did you see how they coordinated their looks for their London outing? Funke and Waje gave us matching buba and iro sets with colourful floral details, while Shoday arrived with a custom embroidered blazer that made its own case for a place in our style notes. The trio were in the UK for the promotional campaign of The Four: No One Fights Alone , and the outing came with another exciting update. Funke Akindele Network and FilmOne Entertainment have announced that the film will have its UK premiere on 29 November at ODEON Luxe Leicester Square in London, ahead of its worldwide cinema release on 11 December. Now, if you’re wondering how Funke and Waje managed to wear matching outfits without looking identical, the answer is in the details. Both looks started with off-white textured cotton, but the floral appliqués gave each one a distinct finish. Funke’s outfit features crimson-red roses with spiral stitching across the bodice and bell sleeves, while yellow sunflowers and leafy green stems run down her wrapper. She completed the look with a golden-yellow head wrap, layered gold necklaces, a broad cuff bracelet and metallic red platform sandals. Funke Akindele Buba and Iro Outfit for The Four London Promo Waje went for lavender roses across the neckline and sleeves of her blouse, with large green floral appliqués decorating the hem of her wrapper. She kept the colour story going with a matching lavender-trimmed scarf, a gold necklace accented with turquoise stones, coordinating earrings and multi-coloured platform heels. Same base colour, different floral story. We love that. Waje outdoors in London promoting The Four: No One Fights Alone in a lavender floral buba and iro set. And Shoday? He clearly had no plans to be the odd one out. His single-breasted blazer featured bold chevron embroidery in turquoise, yellow, red and blue, worn over a beige mesh-knit top and cream wide-leg trousers. Stacked silver Cuban-link chains and dark dress shoes completed the look, giving the colourful jacket room to do its thing. Shoday in a custom geometric chevron-embroidered blazer during The Four promotional tour in London. With the fashion notes taken, we’re also looking forward to seeing what the cast has in store for the London premiere. The Four: No One Fights Alone features Funke Akindele, Waje, Chioma Akpotha, Bisola Aiyeola, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Lateef Adedimeji, Timini Egbuson and Uzor Arukwe, among others. The film premieres at ODEON Luxe Leicester Square on 29 November before its global cinema release on 11 December. item.title: California fights "preposterous" Trump admin demand to scrap state broadband laws
item.description: California is accepting $1.42 billion in broadband grant funding from the Trump administration, but the state is not accepting the Trump administration's demand that it stop enforcing a net neutrality law and other telecom regulations. California's stand against the Trump administration could result in multiple legal battles involving the state, federal government, and Internet providers seeking government funds. Although California told the federal government it would accept the money, it is reserving the right to challenge the condition imposed by the US. The state could delay or cancel plans to distribute broadband grants depending on how the process unfolds. The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) decided last year that states must agree not to enforce any rate regulation or net neutrality rule on ISPs that receive money from the $42 billion Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program. California had to decide whether to accept its share of the fund despite that restriction. California is slated to spend $1.42 billion to deploy broadband to 270,571 locations, and may ultimately receive up to $1.86 billion from BEAD for a mix of deployment and non-deployment projects. item.title: Inter End Champions League Slump With 3-0 Win Over Feyenoord
item.description: Inter Milan got their stuttering Champions League campaign back on track with a comfortable 3-0 win Tuesday against Dutch giants Feyenoord, helped by a superb first-half strike from German defender Yann Bisseck. The three-time champions of Europe had lost their first two group games, but had far too much quality for a disappointing Feyenoord, who had little answer to Inter’s pace and attacking ability. On a clear and crisp evening in Rotterdam, the visitors quickly silenced the ever raucous crowd in De Kuip, piling on sustained pressure that paid dividends as early as the eighth minute. Bisseck was given too much space on the edge of the box, allowed to turn and drill a sumptuous curling left-footed shot low past the diving Tjark Ernst in the Feyenoord goal. Feyenoord struggled to break out of the Inter Milan high press and the Serie A champions dominated possession and territory for much of the first quarter. The home fans had to wait for half an hour before their side produced their first effort of note, a clever one-two playing in Anis Hadj Moussa, who saw his shot blocked. And Inter doubled their advantage shortly afterwards. Feyenoord’s Dutch midfielder #10 Luciano Valente (R) reacts at the end of the the UEFA Champions League, league phase, Matchday 4, football match between Feyenoord and Inter Milan at De Kuip Stadium in Rotterdam on November 3, 2026. (Photo by JOHN THYS / AFP) England international Djed Spence found himself in acres of space on the right hand side. His shot looped up off a defender, allowing Pio Esposito to bundle in with his head from short range. The beginning of the second half brought more misery for Giovanni van Bronckhorst’s men, as Feyenoord’s defence backed off and invited an advancing Piotr Zielinski to shoot. The Polish international midfielder gratefully accepted the invitation, firing home an unstoppable drive off the post on 54 minutes. With the game effectively over as a contest, Inter boss Cristian Chivu rang the changes, bringing off star striker Marcus Thuram. Halfway through the second half, fireworks launched from outside the stadium landed on the pitch and roof, causing a short interruption. And the match itself rather fizzled out, as Inter cruised and Feyenoord failed to find any spark to penetrate the Italian defences. The win saw Inter climb to a more respectable place in the middle of the Champions League table while Feyenoord’s solitary victory leaves them adrift of the knock-out phase. Feyenoord’s next Champions League encounter is a home tie against Porto, while Inter Milan welcome Stuttgart. item.title: Raphinha, Yamal Fire Barcelona To Champions League Win Over Villa
item.description: Raphinha struck twice to propel Barcelona to a 3-0 Champions League win over visitors Aston Villa on Tuesday, ending the English side’s perfect start to the competition. Five-time winners Barcelona took an early lead through Lamine Yamal before Raphinha continued his fine goalscoring form with a second-half brace. Barca bounced back after defeat by champions Paris Saint-Germain in their previous European outing to stay in the hunt for a top eight league phase berth. Unai Emery’s Villa competed well in the first half but were eventually undone by Barca’s greater ability in the final third. The Champions League anthem was not played before the game, as a mark of respect for Tenerife striker Jesus De Miguel, who died on Tuesday morning after an on-pitch collision in a Spanish second division match the previous day, provoking shock across the football world. Villa captain John McGinn had only visited the Camp Nou once previously, on a summer holiday as an eight-year-old, and might have expected better weather than the downpour both teams were subjected to. The skipper might also have expected a more focused start, with Villa handing Barcelona the lead in the seventh minute. Barcelona’s Spanish forward #10 Lamine Yamal (R) and Barcelona’s English forward #17 Anthony Gordon fight for the ball with Aston Villa’s Dutch defender #22 Ian Maatsen (L) and Aston Villa’s Swedish defender #03 Victor Lindelof during the UEFA Champions League 1st round day 4 football match between FC Barcelona and Aston Villa at Camp Nou Stadium in Barcelona on November 3, 2026. (Photo by MANAURE QUINTERO / AFP) The Spanish champions pressed Aston Villa extremely high and Joao Gomes played a poor pass straight to Yamal in his own box. The 19-year-old winger gladly took the gift and stroked past Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki. Villa reacted strongly and Matty Cash had a vicious drive deflected narrowly wide before Joao Cancelo blocked Gomes’s effort. Barcelona goalkeeper Joan Garcia was quick off his line to beat Nicolas Jackson to a dangerous through-ball. Suzuki saved from Anthony Gordon as Villa again struggled to bring the ball out from the back under Barca’s pressing. Garcia was called into action again by Johan Manzambi as the match lurched from end-to-end. Barcelona extended their lead early in the second half when Fermin Lopez fed Raphinha, who showed quick footwork before finding the bottom corner. Cancelo powered a strike narrowly over before setting up Raphinha for Barcelona’s third with a superb cross with the outside of his boot. The Brazil winger, who has made the number nine position his own this season, pounced from close range for his 19th goal of the season across all competitions. Yamal sent a shot skidding wide as Barcelona probed for a fourth. It did not come, but the Catalan giants were able to record a first Champions League clean sheet in 19 games. AFP The post Raphinha, Yamal Fire Barcelona To Champions League Win Over Villa appeared first on Channels Televi

item.title: North Korean fake job interview led to $6.3B Binance heist
item.description: North Korean cryptocurrency thieves tricked a Binance software engineer into downloading malware onto their work-issued computer during a fake job interview process before last week's record-breaking $6.3 billion heist . In an incident report published on Tuesday, the cryptocurrency exchange said several techniques - including social engineering via fake job interviews, malware downloads, compromised internal AI tooling, endpoint takeover, and an “advanced transaction-authorization method” - led to the October 29 security breach. “Our current investigation indicates that this was a sophisticated, multi-stage campaign,” the incident report said. “It was not a single isolated breach or a simple phishing incident.” Over the weekend, the FBI attributed the theft to TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking operation linked to Lazarus Group , known for combining espionage with massive cryptocurrency heists . The Pyongyang-backed crew is also highly adept at job market scams - both posing as IT workers , who are then hired by Western companies , and as potential employers to lure software engineers into downloading malware and infecting corporate devices . With the recent Binance attack, the Norks used the latter. The attack prep began back in June with a supply chain attack when one of its engineers downloaded a malicious Homebrew installation . While the malware was detected by the security team, the device was replaced, and all affected credentials rotated, “Engineer A’s role and his related colleagues on our wallet infrastructure team was exposed to the hacker,” the report says. Three months later, the social engineering part of the attack happened. In September, another software engineer was contacted via a “legitimate job-hunting platform” by someone purporting to be a project director who arranged a series of job interviews for the Binance engineer with the fake company. During the first round - a live video interview with the engineer and a fake HR rep - the interviewer “shared a social media account with him, including personal photos and videos posted on the platform, in order to build trust,” according to the report. “This was more advanced and deceptive than previously seen social engineering approaches.” The second interview with someone purporting to be the CEO of the phony company was conducted on a “popular social chat app,” and toward the end, the CEO instructed the engineer to download an “assignment” containing a malware-laced code repository. The code executed on his work computer during the setup process, which kicked off a series of unauthorized activities. According to Binance, the malware replaced a legitimate development tool component with a malicious version, which executed commands and established communication with an attacker-controlled external server. The attackers also took steps to hide the malicious script and evade detection, and it worked. Binance’s endpoint security tools did not immediately detect the malware. Here’s

item.title: NASA asks industry for ideas about saving Hubble Space Telescope
item.description: null NASA is reviving discussions to rescue the Hubble Space Telescope, which is operating well but is on track to reenter Earth's atmosphere about six years from now. The agency issued a request for information (RFI) on Oct. 29 for "in-space servicing" capabilities, which could include boosting Hubble's orbit (which is naturally degrading due to atmospheric drag), or even a mission to "enhance its capabilities" in some way. Hubble, which launched in April 1990 in partnership with the European Space Agency , was serviced five times by astronauts on space shuttle missions, the most recent being in 2009. The observatory's groundbreaking achievements include helping to show that the expansion of the universe is accelerating — a discovery that won the Nobel Prize — as well as a swath of finds about planets, galaxies, stars and other parts of the universe . Hubble also regularly teams up with other telescopes for science work, and its observations have led to the publication of at least 23,000 scientific papers , NASA figures suggest. And, despite its age, Hubble remains in high demand. "Astronomers request about seven times as much observing time as is available each year," the agency stated in September. Hubble is also widely appreciated by the public. People have long enjoyed and celebrated its iconic images , such as the Eagle Nebula's "Pillars of Creation," a gorgeous shot that has been revisited several times over the decades. As such, this is not the first time in recent years that discussions have opened about keeping the famed observatory running for a while longer. In 2022, for example, billionaire tech entrepreneur Jared Isaacman proposed using SpaceX hardware to mount a Hubble-servicing mission. (Isaacman also purchased and commanded two crewed SpaceX missions to Earth orbit, which flew in September 2021 and September 2024 .) NASA declined , however, citing possible risks to the healthy observatory. But things have changed, apparently. Isaacman, who in December 2025 became NASA administrator, said in an Oct. 30 agency statement that Hubble's science return means the agency should "be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible" — especially if doing so would be a cost savings compared with launching another mission. In an Oct. 30 post on X , Isaacman added that it's "still worth exploring the options" and noted that NASA had previously considered "a far lower-cost solution" to keep the observatory flying. "That was then. Still worth the effort — Hubble deserves it," he added. The new RFI also allows for alternative scenarios, however, which could include a "safe, controlled reentry into Earth's atmosphere or orbital disposal at the end of Hubble's mission." Hubble will naturally enter the atmosphere in 2033 or 2034 due to orbital drag, so any attempt to service it would have to be in 2032, the agency stated. item.title: Microsoft improves Windows 11 performance on 8 GB PCs as RAM prices keep climbing
item.description: With RAM getting more expensive, Microsoft is putting more effort into making Windows 11 run better on systems with just 8 GB of memory. Microsoft said on Tuesday that it was "raising the bar for 8 GB Windows 11 PCs," following a renewed focus on memory optimization earlier this year . The changes come as Redmond continues pushing more expensive Copilot+ PCs, which require at least 16 GB of RAM, amid a memory crunch fueled by AI infrastructure demand. Now, Microsoft says a low-end machine with its 8 GB of precious RAM will be up to 20 percent more responsive and 40 percent faster at multitasking thanks to improvements made in memory management. The tweaks are relatively simple, as Microsoft explained, and seem more about adjusting back to the reality that its flagship operating system needs to function on the hardware people can actually afford to purchase if and when they’re forced to upgrade. Windows 11 will now keep up to 2 GB more active data in memory before shunting it to slower storage, as one example. In another instance, Windows will connect directly to Edge when the browser is already running in the background, allowing it to launch up to 33 percent faster, according to Microsoft. Microsoft apps are also being made more efficient, with Teams able to enable Efficiency Mode by default on 8 GB machines, which Microsoft said will make it launch "up to 20 percent faster." Memory efficiency is also being improved by tweaking things like Widgets, which will only load when used instead of always being on, and decreasing the time when Edge tabs go to sleep from two hours to 15 minutes by default. Microsoft said it’s enabling third-party apps to make use of those tweaks, too. Microsoft also included benchmark data in the blog post from a recent bit of research it commissioned. The benchmark report compares a range of 2026 Windows machines with models from 2021, finding that a 2026 Dell XPS 13 with 8 GB of RAM performed about as well as a 2021 Dell XPS 13 with 16 GB across selected workloads. What that means, says Microsoft, is that “the complete PC, not memory capacity alone, shapes the experience.” In other words, please buy some new Windows hardware, even if it’s expensive - we’re begging you. Software optimization can only do so much. “For many people, 8 GB is a great fit for the things they do every day,” Microsoft EVP of Windows and devices Pavan Davuluri wrote in the blog post. “Demanding workloads, such as 3D modeling, advanced video editing, or large-scale data processing benefit from 16 GB of memory or more.” It’s no surprise Microsoft is improving the performance of lower end systems at the same time it’s subtly asking users to buy newer kit, even if it’s just an 8 GB machine - Microsoft may have done well in the past two quarters, but it’s no thanks to Windows devices.
